data.desc: 111, Inc. (NASDAQ: YI) ('111' or the 'Company') is a leading technology-enabled healthcare platform transforming China's healthcare value chain through digitalization and artificial intelligence (AI). By connecting consumers, pharmacies, pharmaceutical companies and other healthcare participants, 111 aims to make pharmaceutical products and healthcare services more accessible, efficient and affordable, while helping industry participants operate more intelligently. Through its integrated ecosystem, 1 Pharmacy, the Company's online retail pharmacy, provides consumers with convenient access to a broad range of pharmaceutical products and healthcare services. On the B2B side, 1 Medicine offers pharmacies a one-stop digital sourcing platform, helping them improve purchasing efficiency, product availability and inventory management.
